title: Its Burning, Man! (3)
description: Its Burning, Man! (3) — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp.

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 25 Fire Mutant Pincers, 25 Fire Mutant Pukers, 25 Fire Mutant Hulks, and 25 Fire Mutant Twins in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and return to Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp.

Quest Reward: 2500 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: It Keeps Burning, Man!
